text: The Pohang Steelers' 2026 kit carries a Pohang City patch ('포항시 패치', the hometown patch) on the right sleeve, together with the sponsor patch.
short: The right sleeve carries Pohang City's hometown patch.

source.name: K League: [포항] '전통과 정체성 표현'…포항스틸러스 2026시즌 유니폼 공개 [Pohang Steelers unveil 2026 kits]
source.quote: 신규 패치와 포항시 패치가 함께 부착된다
